sql.value: SELECT ast.id AS accountSetId, ast.company_name AS companyName, ast.credit_code AS creditCode, ast.individual_tax_code AS individualTaxCode, ast.province AS province, (SELECT tba.city FROM fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address tba WHERE tba.pin_yin = ast.province LIMIT 1) AS provinceName, DATE_FORMAT(ast.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS accountSetCreateDate, IFNULL(tfs.iit_screenshot_sent, 0) AS iitScreenshotSent, tfs.iit_screenshot_sent_at AS iitScreenshotSentAt, tfs.iit_screenshot_sent_by AS iitScreenshotSentBy, tfs.id AS taxFilingStatusId, JSON_ARRAYAGG( CASE WHEN oct.id IS NOT NULL THEN JSON_OBJECT('ocTaskId', oct.id, 'iitType', oct.iit_type, 'finishedAt', oct.finished_at, 'urls', oct.urls) END ) AS ocTasksJson FROM fxy_financial_account_sets ast INNER JOIN fxy_financial_user_account_sets uas ON uas.account_sets_id = ast.id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_tax_filing_status tfs ON tfs.account_set_id = ast.id AND tfs.tax_period = :taxPeriod LEFT JOIN ( SELECT z.account_set_id, z.id, z.iit_type, z.finished_at, z.urls FROM ( SELECT t.account_set_id, t.id, t.finished_at, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.result_json, '$.iit_type')) AS iit_type, JSON_EXTRACT(t.result_json, '$.screenshot_urls') AS urls, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY t.account_set_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(t.result_json, '$.iit_type')) ORDER BY t.finished_at DESC, t.id DESC ) AS rn FROM fxy_financial_oc_task t WHERE t.period = :taxPeriod AND t.task_type = 'iit_declare' AND t.result_json IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(t.result_json) AND JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(t.result_json, '$.screenshot_urls')) > 0 ) z WHERE z.rn = 1 ) oct ON oct.account_set_id = ast.id WHERE uas.user_id = :currentUserId AND ast.deactivated = b'0' #[AND (ast.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', :keyword, '%') OR ast.credit_code LIKE CONCAT('%', :keyword, '%'))] #[AND (ast.province LIKE CONCAT('%', :province, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_tax_bureau_address tba2 WHERE tba2.pin_yin = ast.province AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(tba2.city, '（', 1), '(', 1) LIKE CONCAT('%', :province, '%')))] #[AND IFNULL(tfs.iit_screenshot_sent, 0) = :sent] GROUP BY ast.id #[HAVING ((:hasShot = 1 AND COUNT(oct.id) > 0) OR (:hasShot = 0 AND COUNT(oct.id) = 0))] ORDER BY ast.create_date DESC, ast.id DESC
